question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill the blank.

The strike, that the truck association called, caused a minor _______ of food in our village.
solution:
```html
The correct answer is '**dearth**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**dearth**" means a scarcity or lack of something. (कमी)
 
• The sentence implies that the strike caused a shortage or scarcity of food in the village.
 
• The other options: "**availability**," "**loss**," and "**leak**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The strike, that the truck association called, caused a minor dearth__ of food in our village.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Availability (उपलब्धता)**: means being accessible or obtainable.
 
• **Loss (हानि)**: means losing something or suffering a decrease.
 
• **Leak (रिसाव)**: means the accidental escape of a substance.

```
